card.text: Dark moon of Saturn on a backward orbit, probably a captured object.

introduction.text: Phoebe reflects only about 6% of the sunlight it receives. It may be a captured centaur from the outer solar system.

normal.title: SPC relative brightness model
normal.summary: Brightness from the 2023 Cassini shape and albedo model, relative to about 1; not natural color or geometric albedo.

iss.title: Cassini ISS narrow-angle image
iss.summary: One Cassini photograph from the 2004 approach, projected onto the shape.

elevation.title: Q512 radial height model
elevation.summary: Radius minus a 106.5 km sphere, in km. Less certain where few images were taken.

maplet-resolution.title: SPC maplet resolution
maplet-resolution.summary: The finest map spacing that went into each 1° cell. Finer input does not guarantee accurate heights.

image-count.title: SPC image coverage
image-count.summary: How many images covered each 1° cell. Fewer than five calls for caution.

infrared.title: Cassini VIMS regional spectra
infrared.summary: False color from 2.02, 1.59 and 1.28 µm over a small region seen in June 2004; placement is uncertain by kilometres.

ice-absorption.title: VIMS regional water-ice absorption
ice-absorption.summary: Water-ice absorption near 2.02 µm in a small 2004 flyby region; it does not measure ice abundance.
